_note: After two failed attacks in the native representation, a third native attack is forbidden. Require a structure-preserving map to an orthogonal representation, stating what it preserves and where the obstruction reappears. A pivot is a direction, never a result: everything it produces enters CONJECTURE and must still be carried out and checked.

graph_theory.encoding: encode the graph as its adjacency/Laplacian matrix; combinatorial quantities become eigenvalue/eigenvector statements
graph_theory.preserves: adjacency structure <-> matrix entries; degree <-> row sums
graph_theory.reflects: a combinatorial obstruction becomes a spectral gap / rank obstruction

graph_theory.encoding: encode incidences as polynomial (non)vanishing; use the combinatorial Nullstellensatz / polynomial method
graph_theory.reflects: an extremal bound becomes a degree/dimension bound

number_theory.encoding: work in Z/mZ or a finite field; arithmetic constraints become finite-algebra / character-sum statements
number_theory.reflects: a local obstruction becomes a non-vanishing character sum

number_theory.encoding: encode the set as an indicator and pass to its Fourier transform
number_theory.reflects: an additive obstruction becomes a spectrum/large-coefficient obstruction

additive_combinatorics.encoding: pass to the Fourier transform of the indicator; structure <-> spectrum
additive_combinatorics.reflects: small doubling becomes Fourier concentration on a Bohr set

additive_combinatorics.encoding: transfer to a measure-preserving system via Furstenberg correspondence
additive_combinatorics.reflects: a density obstruction becomes a non-recurrence obstruction

order_theory.encoding: give the order its Alexandrov/Scott topology; order properties become topological ones
order_theory.reflects: an order obstruction becomes a non-closed / non-compact witness

geometry.encoding: encode points/incidences as polynomial (non)vanishing; apply the polynomial method / combinatorial Nullstellensatz
geometry.preserves: collinearity and incidence <-> polynomial roots; degrees of freedom <-> degree
geometry.reflects: an incidence/extremal-geometry bound becomes a degree/dimension bound

geometry.encoding: abstract the geometric configuration to its order-type / oriented matroid, then count via Ramsey/Dilworth-type extremal arguments
geometry.preserves: convex-position and general-position predicates <-> forbidden sub-configurations
geometry.reflects: a convexity obstruction becomes a forbidden monotone sub-configuration

combinatorics.encoding: associate each set/object with a vector (incidence/inclusion or characteristic vector) over a field; an extremal family becomes a set of (near-)independent vectors
combinatorics.preserves: set intersections <-> inner products; a forbidden intersection pattern <-> a rank/independence constraint
combinatorics.reflects: an extremal set-system bound becomes a dimension bound in a vector space

combinatorics.encoding: encode a random member of the family by its structure; bound the family size by the entropy / a reversible encoding (spread + sunflower / entropy method)
combinatorics.preserves: family size <-> encoding length; spread structure <-> conditional entropy
combinatorics.reflects: an extremal cardinality bound becomes an entropy / encoding-length bound

analysis.encoding: recast functions as vectors in a Banach/Hilbert space and the operation as a bounded operator; pointwise claims become operator-norm / spectral statements
analysis.preserves: convergence <-> norm convergence; a kernel/transform <-> an operator
analysis.reflects: a pointwise obstruction becomes an unbounded-operator / divergent-norm obstruction

analysis.encoding: pass to the Fourier/spectral side; smoothness and decay trade places
analysis.reflects: a concentration obstruction becomes a frequency-support obstruction

algebra.encoding: act the group/ring on a vector space; structural questions become module/character statements
algebra.reflects: a structural obstruction becomes a non-trivial module decomposition

algebra.encoding: pass between an ideal and its vanishing locus (Nullstellensatz); algebra <-> geometry of Spec
algebra.preserves: ideal containment <-> subvariety inclusion; primes <-> points
algebra.reflects: a solvability obstruction becomes an empty or positive-dimensional variety

topology.encoding: apply a homology/homotopy functor; continuous obstructions become computable invariants
topology.preserves: continuous maps <-> induced homomorphisms; holes <-> nontrivial classes
topology.reflects: a no-continuous-map obstruction becomes a nonzero (co)homology class

topology.encoding: triangulate / model the space as a simplicial complex or nerve; topology becomes finite combinatorics
topology.reflects: a topological obstruction becomes a property of a finite complex

probability.encoding: treat the quantity as a function of independent randomness; bound deviations by concentration
probability.preserves: typical value <-> expectation; rare events <-> exponential tails
probability.reflects: an existence obstruction becomes a positive-probability lower bound

probability.encoding: expose the randomness step by step as a filtration; the process becomes a (sub/super)martingale
probability.preserves: fair increments <-> martingale; deadlines <-> stopping times
probability.reflects: a global expectation obstruction becomes a stopped-process identity

logic.encoding: study the class of models of the theory; syntactic questions become semantic/structural ones
logic.preserves: provability <-> truth in all models; consistency <-> a model exists
logic.reflects: an unprovability obstruction becomes two models disagreeing

logic.encoding: encode the statement as a propositional/first-order formula; hardness becomes proof-length / refutation complexity
logic.preserves: validity <-> unsatisfiability of the negation; a proof <-> a refutation
logic.reflects: a no-short-proof obstruction becomes a resolution-width lower bound
